parent.intent: Host the API, UI, and integration agents on one fork.

subs.intent: Change the API handler and name the contract api.
subs.command: mkdir -p src/api && printf '%s\n' 'export function handler() { return "api"; }' > src/api/handler.js && printf '%s\n' 'export const label = "api";' > src/contract.js

subs.intent: Change the UI view and name the contract ui.
subs.command: mkdir -p src/ui && printf '%s\n' 'export function view() { return "ui"; }' > src/ui/view.js && printf '%s\n' 'export const label = "ui";' > src/contract.js

subs.intent: Add an integration check. Do not receive evaluator authority.
subs.command: mkdir -p test/integration && printf '%s\n' 'export function check(label) { return label === "api+ui"; }' > test/integration/check.js
